message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by 56 delegates to the Continental Congress. The most well‑known signers include:

| Signer | State | Notable Contributions |
|--------|-------|-----------------------|
| John Hancock | Massachusetts | President of the Second Continental Congress; his large signature became a symbol of boldness |
| Thomas Jefferson | Virginia | Principal author of the Declaration |
| Benjamin Franklin | Pennsylvania | Renowned statesman, scientist, and diplomat |
| George Washington | Virginia | Commander-in-chief of the Continental Army |
| John Adams | Massachusetts | Future second President of the United States |
| Samuel Adams | Massachusetts | Revolutionary leader and political activist |
| Patrick Henry | Virginia | Famous for his “Give me liberty, or give me death!” speech |
| James Madison | Virginia | Future fourth President and key architect of the Constitution |
| Alexander Hamilton | New York | Future first Secretary of Treasury |
| John Jay | New York | Future first Chief Justice of the Supreme Court |
